v0.2.0.description:
First public beta of the Archipelago World for Alundra (PlayStation).

The apworld handles contains both the patcher and the bizhawk client. You only need your own USA Rev 1 (1.1) disc image.

## Features
- Generate an Alundra slot with the usual options (crests, progressive items, split boots, starting kit, and more)
- Remote items from other games appear in Alundra chests and one-time shops, labeled with the other player's name and the item name
- BizHawk Lua client (Nymashock) sends checks and receives items
- Goal is Melzas; the client reports completion when the ending loads
- Launcher "Alundra Patch" button turns an `.apalundra` file plus your disc into a playable BIN/CUE
- Full healing stacks received from another game pay out as gilder when inventory is full
- Restocking shop shelves can be set to vanilla, randomized, or full variety (they are not checks)
- Progression items are kept off non-check locations (including the Fairy Pond)

## Not implemented in this beta
- Fairy Pond chests (pond closes after the reward)
- Dreams
- In-game Archipelago hints registering on AP server (hints are baked into dialogue at patch time)

## Setup
See [docs/setup_en.md](https://github.com/Lunesar/alundra-apworld/blob/master/docs/setup_en.md): Archipelago 0.6.7+, install `alundra.apworld`, generate, patch, then BizHawk + the included Lua connector.

## Downloads
`alundra.apworld` is the only file players need and supports both Windows and Linux. Drop it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` or use Install APWorld.
